source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Factory pattern (PDF 25).

blocks.text: Factory Design Pattern ek khaas workshop jaisa hai jo mukhtalif products banana janti hai, lekin aap ko yeh fikr nahi karni ke woh products kaise bante hain. Aap bas factory ko batate hain ke aap ko kya chahiye, aur woh aap ko tayyar product de deti hai.

blocks.prompt: Factory Pattern bayan karein aur bataein ke yeh objects ko seedha banane se kaise mukhtalif hai, misal ke saath. (Short Question 8)
blocks.explanation: Seedha banane mein jis code ko object chahiye usi ko theek class ka naam aur banane ka tareeqa maloom hona chahiye. Factory ke saath code sirf factory se maangta hai ('mujhe circle chahiye') aur factory khud tay karti hai ke kaun si class aur kaise banani hai. Misal: drawing app shape factory se 'circle' ya 'square' maang kar tayyar shape leti hai; nayi shape add karni ho to sirf factory badalti hai, baqi program nahi.

items: Factory: factory ko batao kya chahiye, woh tayyar object de deti hai; banane ki tafseel chhupi rehti hai (workshop ki tarah).
